features.title: Source-grounded CLI catalog and thin-baseline score
acceptance: A caller can submit declared surfaces or a supported Python/ipcMain source subset and receive one grounded command per surface.
Each command is marked executable only when the handler, route, and required flags bind.
The same inventory is scored against a fixed start/stop/status/chat/meeting baseline.
Analyses persist in SQLite and can be listed, filtered, opened, and exported.
The labeled evaluation command reports precision and recall for both generators.

features.title: Replay a user-supplied argv against a saved command
acceptance: A saved analysis accepts an argv and returns the bound parameters or the bind failure.

features.title: Score an agent-authored command list
acceptance: A pasted command list is compared with the grounded executable set and returns precision and recall.

features.title: Optional advisory explanation of bind failures
acceptance: When LLM_API_KEY is set, a failure explanation is requested from the configured provider and labeled advisory.
Missing or failing provider calls return an error and do not invent a successful explanation.

features.title: Keycloak OIDC login and role checks
acceptance: Authorization-code login with state, nonce, and PKCE protects every data endpoint.
Viewer, operator, and admin roles are enforced, and logout clears the session.
